copy.title: App Toolkit: Everyday tools in one app
copy.headline: Everyday tools, one app
copy.description: App Toolkit for Android: Water Eject, Ruler and Protractor, Unit Converter, Tip and Bill Splitter, Decision Wheel and more, in one app.
copy.longDescription: One app. Many everyday moments. A drop in a speaker and the tone that pushes it out; the last wave flattens into a ruler that measures 76.0 mm; the reading becomes a conversion; the conversion folds into a receipt split two ways; a wheel lands on Music, and its confetti becomes the app's tools, which gather into App Toolkit.
copy.altText: A drop on a speaker grille cuts to Water Eject on a Pixel phone; a sound wave flattens into a ruler; 76.0 mm becomes 7.6 cm; the unit cards fold into a receipt split in two; a decision wheel lands on Music and its confetti turns into the app's tools, which gather into the App Toolkit icon and the Get it on Google Play badge.
